contradictions.description: Lavender placement: official PdM US website = HEART note. Fragrantica, theperfumespot, fragrancelord = TOP note. Lavender is a structurally important note in Layton's character; its placement in the pyramid determines whether it is perceived as part of the opening or the body of the fragrance.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Official PdM US website (DIRECT_ACCESS_SUCCESS) is the authoritative current presentation; Fragrantica-derived listing is documented as the widely circulated alternative.

contradictions.description: Cardamom placement: official PdM US website = TOP note. Fragrantica = BASE note. fragrancelord omits Cardamom entirely.
Mandarin Orange: present in Fragrantica and theperfumespot (top notes). Absent from official PdM US website listing.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Cannot be confirmed which is authoritative.

contradictions.description: Gender classification: official PdM US website positions Layton as masculine (under 'For Men' category). Fragrantica classifies it 'for women and men'. Walmart lists it as 'Unisex'. The official brand position is masculine; community and database classification is wider.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Official brand = masculine. Fragrantica / community = for men and women.

canonicalSummary: Layton by Parfums de Marly is a 2016 Eau de Parfum created by Hamid Merati-Kashani. The official Parfums de Marly US website lists it under Masculine and For Men categories; Fragrantica classifies it for women and men. The fragrance family is Oriental Floral (Fragrantica). Two substantially different note pyramids were obtained: (1) Official PdM US website (DIRECT_ACCESS_SUCCESS): Top: Apple, Bergamot, Cardamom; Heart: Lavender, Violet, Geranium; Base: Patchouli, Vanilla, Guaicwood, Praline. (2) Fragrantica-derived (widely circulated, SEARCH_SNIPPET_ONLY): Top: Apple, Lavender, Bergamot, Mandarin Orange; Heart: Geranium, Violet, Jasmine; Base: Vanilla, Cardamom, Sandalwood, Pepper, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Ambermax™, Coumarin. Both note pyramids are documented with their sources. The discrepancy may reflect different disclosure standards, a simplified official pyramid, or reformulation. Community characterizes Layton as fresh-spicy-vanilla with apple-bergamot opening, lavender heart, and vanilla-woody base — a year-round, daytime-to-evening masculine. All findings concern the reference fragrance only and do not constitute evidence about Maison Skye & Rose's inspired formulation.
